intended_question: Given information legitimately available about an eligible adult at the index encounter, estimate the experimental probability of a first recorded essential-hypertension event within the following five years.

population.index_requirement: first eligible encounter containing a paired systolic and diastolic blood-pressure observation
population.dataset: Synthea Massachusetts synthetic CSV cohort; requested 5000 living patients, 5724 exported histories

index.timestamp: calendar day of the qualifying encounter stop
index.same_encounter_rule: observations linked to the qualifying encounter and dated no later than encounter stop are available

target_event.duplicate_policy: deduplicate to earliest qualifying condition date

exclusions_and_censoring.positive: first target event occurs after index and within 1825 days
exclusions_and_censoring.negative: no target event in the horizon and encounter record extends through the horizon
exclusions_and_censoring.censored: no event and record/death ends before the horizon
exclusions_and_censoring.deceased: eligible when follow-up is sufficient or the event precedes death; otherwise censored

features.name: age_years
features.transformation: whole elapsed years at index; serialize as numeric

features.name: sex_at_birth
features.transformation: Synthea F/M to female/male; intersex, prefer_not_to_say and null to unknown
features.missing: explicit unknown category fitted within training pipeline

features.name: systolic_blood_pressure
features.transformation: latest in lookback; unit spelling normalized only

features.name: diastolic_blood_pressure
features.transformation: latest in lookback; unit spelling normalized only

features.name: heart_rate
features.transformation: latest in lookback; /min normalized to bpm

features.name: bmi
features.runtime_source: backend-derived BMI from authoritative height and latest weight
features.transformation: latest in lookback; no client-submitted BMI

features.name: smoking_status
features.transformation: Never smoked tobacco→never; Ex-smoker→former; Smokes tobacco daily→current
features.missing: explicit unknown category fitted within training pipeline

excluded_candidate_features.weight: excluded from v1 because BMI carries the same body-size signal and avoids redundant correlated inputs
excluded_candidate_features.blood_glucose: 58.72% missing at selected index and not necessary for the target question
excluded_candidate_features.sleep_duration: not emitted by this Synthea generation under the runtime code
excluded_candidate_features.physical_activity_duration: not emitted by this Synthea generation under the runtime code
excluded_candidate_features.prior_conditions: no reviewed, frozen crosswalk from Synthea codes to the current runtime structured history

missingness_policy.fit_scope: all learned imputation and encoding parameters fit on training only
missingness_policy.optional_numeric: median imputation with explicit missing indicator

imbalance.xgboost: derive scale_pos_weight from training negatives/positives only

evaluation.calibration: reliability curve and Brier score; calibration method considered using validation only
evaluation.threshold: choose on validation using a predeclared sensitivity/precision utility; never optimize on test
evaluation.uncertainty: patient-level stratified bootstrap 95% confidence intervals on the untouched test set; report unstable or undefined estimates
